viewing_note: Calls were original, usage720, thumbnail320. The first original display exposed only an upper-left fragment; one revisit of the exact original displayed the complete native image. No crop or pixel editing was performed.

residuals.observation: Paper reaches the bottom frame and its top edge rises toward the right; the planned fully inset frontal sheet is not entirely bounded within the frame.
English identity and brush title are larger than the assigned proportions; lower conditions start near x260 and attendance near x390 instead of the planned x205 and x320.
Broad tan bevel resembles a wooden mount. The slab is separated from the full impression, with no unambiguous peel/contact edge; the relief-to-paper transfer is inferred from matching motifs.
Leaf and two bars occupy a taller cluster than the planned 85 by 45 footprint.

All eleven copy entries occur once, with practical details readable. Activity, date/time/place/entry, and lower conditions form consecutive groups.
Brush title remains legible with complete syllables; calm factual Hangul has consistent square proportions and open counters. Word spaces separate supplied words.

Carved brush contours, coral faces, plum fields and restrained yellow paper grain form a consistent flat drawing. Some impression and title grain intentionally breaks ink fill without breaking text.
